content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies while avoiding the usual restrictions and fees associated with traditional payment platforms. This model is particularly advantageous for digital creators operating in countries where access to mainstream payment processors is limited. With the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH, you can establish a fully operational online store that enables seamless transactions and empowers you to retain more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling Notion templates comprises multiple free and low-cost components that work together to create a seamless selling experience. By utilizing platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, paired with Google Apps Script for backend logic, you can automate product delivery and payment verification. Integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without the need for buyer accounts. This architecture not only eliminates dependency on traditional payment platforms but also ensures data ownership and control over your sales process.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is designed specifically for digital creators who face barriers from conventional payment processors. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, or templates, if you are situated in a region where PayPal or Stripe is restricted, this infrastructure is your solution. It allows you to conduct business independently, ensuring that you can monetize your digital products effectively and efficiently without being hindered by geopolitical or financial constraints.
Eliminate platform fees and retain more of your earnings with a 0.5% transaction fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereignty of your digital commerce stack relies on several key components. First, you have the hosting layer with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which deliver your content reliably. Then, backend logic is handled using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating tasks like payment confirmation and product delivery. For order storage, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 manages file delivery. Finally, NOWPayments enables cryptocurrency transactions, making the entire system robust and efficient for creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own system for selling Notion templates, start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script to automate your payment processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you have a wallet ready to receive payments. Utilize Google Sheets or Supabase for order management, and upload your Notion templates to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy delivery. For comprehensive guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely feasible using cryptocurrency payment processors. By setting up an infrastructure using tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments, you can bypass the traditional payment barriers. This approach not only reduces transaction fees significantly but also gives you full control over your sales.
